about: Replay Theater: tip videos from the YouTube Tip Treasure Chest (Notion). stations[0] is the main station. Weekly runs may append.

videos.title: Every Claude 2.0 Concept Explained for Normal People
videos.sum: A plain-English tour of 25 Claude features, from picking a model and effort level to skills, connectors, mods and /goal, with tips on which ones to set up first.
take: Write a lean CLAUDE.md
Build one skill for your most frequent task
Try a few /goal prompts with a clear finish line
Then build your own “AI operating system” in Claude Code

videos.title: I Tested Claude Fable 5.2 vs Opus 5.5 (WILD RESULTS)
videos.sum: Brock runs Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5 on the same three jobs (a website, a 3D game and a video edit) and finds Fable costs only about 14% more, with its clearest win on the game.
take: Judge models by cost per finished task, not list price
Default to Opus for everyday work; try Fable on big, complex or visual builds
Put a self-check loop in big prompts: “play through it, screenshot it, keep improving”
For repeat work, give Claude examples of finished results plus a one-page style brief
Always review for small but critical misses

videos.title: The 6 NEW Claude Features to Get You Ahead of 99% in 2027
videos.sum: Six new Claude features, including Record a Skill, finished docs and decks, Claude Code Projects, phone remote control and Claude Duet, that shift you from chatting to delegating.
take: Give Claude small real tasks all day, not just occasional questions
Use Record a Skill once for personal tasks Claude can’t guess
Ask for sources on each slide and talking points in the speaker notes
Feed Claude Design real inspiration to avoid generic-looking results
Turn on remote control in Settings → Code

videos.title: Claude Whiteboards Are Here (And They’re Impressive)
videos.sum: Claude’s Whiteboards canvas: turning a folder into an editable visual, working together through comments Claude acts on, and building a clickable prototype to hand to Claude Code.
take: Open Whiteboards with the chat panel and attach a whole folder
Save a design system once and reuse it
Use comments with @Claude for precise changes, then check it changed the right thing
Prototype clickable flows on a whiteboard before building
When handing a board to Claude Code, tell it to match the visual design, not just the text

videos.title: Give Me 10 Minutes and I’ll Make Your Claude 100X Better
videos.sum: Why old-style prompt templates now hold Claude back, and what to do instead: plain requests, yes/no checks for “done,” the right effort level, a slimmer CLAUDE.md and a few usage-saving mods.
take: Rewrite go-to prompts as plain requests with a little context and one example
End prompts with “ask me questions if anything is unclear”
Replace “check your work” with 3–5 yes/no checks
Pick effort by how much you want to steer; default to medium
Ask Claude to simplify your CLAUDE.md

videos.title: The Only Video You’ll Need to Master Claude for 2027
videos.sum: Fifteen tips for the newest Claude models, from writing briefs instead of prompts and matching effort to the task to using sub-agents, Projects and side chats while keeping your setup lean.
take: Write a brief: the job, the why, the rules, what done looks like, plus “be ambitious”
Ask for several options, and /rewind instead of piling on corrections
Default to medium effort
Use /compact and side chats to keep the main chat sharp
Prune skills, connectors, scheduled tasks and context files regularly

videos.title: Claude for Beginners: Full Course (2026)
videos.sum: A no-code beginner’s course on the Claude desktop app covering Projects, Skills, Connectors, Artifacts, scheduled tasks and plugins, ending with a live build of a job-search agent.

videos.title: How to Transfer to Claude Teams Account (Without Losing Your Data)
videos.sum: A step-by-step guide to moving your personal Claude setup, including skills, scheduled tasks, artifacts, chats and memory, into a Claude Team account without losing anything.

videos.title: Claude Engineering Lead: “Stop Using Claude Like It’s 2024”
videos.sum: An interview with Anthropic engineering lead Felix Rieseberg on giving Claude bigger goals and full access to your data, skipping role-play personas and stale skills, and catching confident mistakes with a separate reviewer session.

videos.title: How I’m Actually Using Claude Duet (After 10 Hours of Testing)
videos.sum: A hands-on review of Claude Duet covering channels, task threads and editing slide decks by voice, how it compares with Claude Projects and ChatGPT, and where it still falls short.

videos.title: Claude Duet Is Here: The End of Prompting?
videos.sum: A week with Claude Duet, the app that messages you first, used for morning briefs with drafted replies, project management, pitching ideas and following up on email.

videos.title: Anthropic Just Dropped Claude Themes (Make Your Own)
videos.sum: How to make custom themes for Claude Code in the desktop app, from a one-prompt color scheme to animated backgrounds that react while Claude works and celebrate when it finishes.

videos.title: How to Get Dangerously Good With Claude
videos.sum: A five-layer roadmap from better prompts to Projects, Skills built from your own corrections, scheduled tasks that run without you, and an optional “agentic OS” folder you own.

videos.title: I Turned Claude Duet Into My Personal Assistant (Full Setup)
videos.sum: A six-step Claude Duet setup: connect your apps, give it your goals, set clear ground rules, lock down security, control your computer through Claude in Chrome, and use voice.
